description.value: The Kimberley Aquatic Centre is a municipally operated public swimming facility run by the City of Kimberley in the East Kootenays. In addition to a pool, OSM records indicate it offers a hot tub and steam room, making it a potentially appealing recovery stop for cyclists finishing a day on the region's renowned trail network. It is one of the main indoor recreation facilities serving the Kimberley community.
